question: The Keoladeo National Park is located in the state of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Keoladeo National Park is located in the Bharatpur district of Rajasthan__.
 
• It is formerly known as the Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary.
 
• This site was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1985.
 
• It became a bird sanctuary in 1956 and was declared a national park in 1981.
 
• It was renamed Keoladeo for the ancient temple in the park dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva.
